title:
🌺We are holding our sing and strum sessions every Tuesday in Ramsbottom from tomorrow!

🐏Bury Libraries Ramsbottom Library - 10:30am-12pm - £8pp

🐏Rammy Men The Den - 5:30-7pm - £6pp

🪕No experience required.

🪕No ukulele? No problem, hire one of ours for the duration of session for additional £2.

🪕Beginners and experienced Ukulele players welcomed, we love to demonstrate tips, techniques and theoretical knowledge in the field of music to bolster your playing/practice routine, with expert guidance from professional musicians.

🚨Limited spaces available, please email ukegroupnorth@gmail.com for more information on how to reserve your space.

Please also visit https://rammymen.org to find out more about their incredible work in the community and their list of activities, such as:

Thai Chi/Qigong - Tuesday 4pm-5pm 

A fantastic way to focus the body and mind before playing some music with all of us at Uke Group North CIC! 🤙
